title: Insurance Funnel
purpose: Why insurance conversion dropped in lease checkout (incident #1547, opened and closed 2026-09-28) and whether October recovered. Scope: this is the Sign funnel only, the coverage choice at checkout (Master Policy or HO4) plus HBG at the deposit step. Contents, claims, renewals, outside-policy verification, and the Pay offers are other funnels. All insurance lines, their owner (Josh Tebbs), and their economics are on The model tab under Economics by line.

sections.title: Where insurance is offered
sections.body: Insurance is offered on Sign (lease checkout: sign, renew, transfer) and again on Pay (when a resident logs in to pay rent). Conversion should be read per surface; a drop on one with a flat rate on the other points at placement, not product.
